scoring_contract.padding: left padding to model.maxlen; holes preserve array positions
scoring_contract.padding_key_exclusion: unverified; zero embeddings do not prove exclusion

metric_definitions.dataset: Dataset identifier exposed by view; unspecified means routing identity was unavailable.
metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Legacy name: (sampled mean off-diagonal item-embedding cosine + 1)/2, rounded to four decimals. Computed by the squared-sum identity without a Gram matrix. Directional alignment only; not proof of collapse or diversity. Null if omitted, fewer than two items exist, or a sampled vector has zero norm.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative training logit over nonpadding sequence/positive/negative positions in up to ten loader batches; null if absent.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Empirical lower tenth percentile of the same training margins; null if absent.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of valid training pairs with margin < 0; null if absent.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of valid training pairs with margin < 0.5; null if absent.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Category lists stay empty because item categories are unavailable. Counts describe training positions only.
metric_definitions.scoring_contract: Actual view encoder/scorer with final array-position readout. Candidate scoring uses B x 1 x D features and B x 1 x K items, matching the sequence margin contract. When model.predict exists, every evaluated baseline must agree at rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-5; the recorded error is the maximum across checked users. Position/mask controls remain unsupported, so holes cannot identify pure recency dependence.
metric_definitions.temporal_training_pairs: Final training event is target, preceding context is prefix, including earlier target occurrences. Fixed target plus 99 unique uniform negatives excludes original prefix. Ties use descending score then ascending item ID. Ranks are one-based, reciprocal rank=1/rank, hr10=1(rank<=10), sampled_top10_overlap=intersection size/10. Differences are changed minus baseline. Repeats average within user before means and 1000 seed-42 user bootstrap percentile intervals. Intervals condition on this fixed trained model and candidate pools. Targets participated in optimization. Packed deletion changes positions; holes have unverified padding behavior. Substitutions preserve positions with unseen same-frequency-decile items or deterministic nearest-decile fallback; these can be out of distribution. Training-fitted dot-product, normalized-similarity and frequency-weighted add-one transition controls are descriptive, not generalization evidence.
metric_definitions.descriptive_strata: Same paired summaries split by truncated prefix length and repeated-ID fraction. Overlapping descriptive groups; repeated IDs do not establish semantic purpose.
metric_definitions.counts: Eligibility requires five preceding training events. Simulator users are independently selected from nonempty complete training histories, up to five per dataset.
metric_definitions.four_dataset_macro_difference: Unavailable in a single-view call. Never substitute a subset-category average. Requires all four dataset outcomes and independent within-dataset user resampling with equal category weights.
metric_definitions.official_validation_hr10: Unavailable: this adapter reads training histories only and does not call or reconstruct the host evaluator.
metric_definitions.checkpoint_validation_associations: Unavailable without externally logged checkpoint identities and official validation aggregates. No Spearman correlations, direction agreement, category consistency or validation intervals are fabricated.
metric_definitions.omissions: Explicit optional-budget and candidate-availability omissions; unsupported positional controls appear in scoring_contract.
metric_definitions.elapsed_wall_seconds: Measured elapsed wall time through metric construction; not a measured GPU-time total.
metric_definitions.budget: Optional work stops at user boundaries after a 150-second per-dataset wall allowance. Required full-catalog scoring runs first and may exceed it; this is not a hard GPU-time cap. Four dataset calls allocate 600 optional wall seconds in total.
